description: Visual full-body scale relative to Nia. These are consistent character model sizes, not biographical heights. Scaling is uniform in both axes and shared by every full-body pose and facing.
review: Nia remains the native-size reference. Mrs. Vale's casual face is roughly one third taller in the source canvas; 196/256 brings her head near Nia's size while retaining her shorter body. Other cast members keep smaller, individual stature differences instead of being forced to a common pixel height.
